services.name: Tour #2: Roundtrip Transportation
services.desc: Great way to explore Charleston! 11 Hours & 15 Minutes 7am - 6:15pm About our Roundtrip Transportation We drop you off at The City Market when we arrive in Charleston (aprrox 9:30 am) This tour includes the 2 items listed below: 1. Roundtrip transportation to Charleston. 2. Approximately 6 hours to shop the City Market or Free Time to do whatever you wish. (pick up is at 3:30-3:45 to return) General Information At approximately 7:00 AM we depart for Charleston. We offer free pickup from most Ocean Front hotels in Myrtle Beach. Sit back and relax as our plush air-conditioned motor Explore Charleston On Your Own! · 11 Hours · All Ages

services.name: Tour #5: Classic City Overview Tour Package
services.desc: Day Trip Package with Historic downtown City Bus Tour, City Market, and Boone Hall Plantation! 11 Hours & 15 Minutes 7am - 6:15pm Our “Classic City Overview Tour” Includes the items listed below: 1. Roundtrip transportation to Charleston. 2. A tour of Charleston’s Historic District on a Tour Bus with a licensed Tour Guide. 4. Approximately two hours to shop the City Market and enjoy lunch on your own. 5. An afternoon at Boone Hall: America's most photographed plantation! Visit the historic slave cabins, newly renovated Cotton Gin building, house tours, self guided garden tours. Historic District Tour, Market Shopping & Boone Hall Plantation

services.name: Tour #7: 'See It All' Inclusive Day Trip
services.desc: Everything you need to get the full Charleston experience! 11 Hours & 15 Minutes 7am - 6:15pm Our 'See It All Inclusive Day Trip' Includes the items listed below: 1. Roundtrip transportation to Charleston. 2.A morning of shopping time in the market OR choose between 2 optional upgrades DELUXE TOUR Add a tour of Charleston’s Historic District on a Tour Bus with a licensed Tour Guide. PREMIUM TOUR Add a one house carriage tour of historic downtown Charleston. An iconic Charleston tour experience! Optional city tours allow for approximately one hour to shop the City Market afterwards. Best Selling Tour! The Ultimate Charleston Experience!
